text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Is your hair the water-repellent type, Hayahide-san?
I think a milk-type shampoo would work well,
though I'm sure you've already tried that, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's better than the oil-based ones.
Still, rainy days and winter are the absolute worst.
Humidity or static makes it frizz and wave up.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah, for static electricity, spraying some water-diluted hair conditioner onto your clothes works pretty well to prevent it!
I do it a lot when wearing stockings.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hoh, the effect of surfactants, you say...
Good to know. I shall try it out.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Seafood... chop suey?
I came to buy shampoo, so why food?!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You're talking about ingredients, right?
I don't get it at all, though.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for talking your ear off.
If you'd like, I can give you two some advice too!
Are you interested in UV protection?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Actually, a sunburn is just like a thermal burn.
Your body uses energy to repair it, making some people exhausted.
I'm one of those people, too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh, from UV rays...?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
That's why hair and skin care are an absolute must.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
There are many kinds of sunscreen, you know.
I think a spray type would be easy to use, but what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
UWOOOOOOH~~~!!
Giving advice to me too, you're
soooo kiiiiind~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Taishi~n, let's learn together!
Hair care is super important for races too, you know!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, stop pulling me!
I'm trying to think right now...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu, did I manage to catch your interest a little?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Speed is crucial for a miler.
In theory, high-rebound materials are ideal,
but they might place too much strain on Flight.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, the derived solution is a thick sole.
For instance, even if the insole provides cushioning, if combined with the resilience of the midsole—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I see!
Hayahide-san's formula is so educational/helpful.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa!!
Cushioning and responsiveness, huh?!
I don't really get it, but it sounds super strong!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Daring not to stick to the conventional theory, huh.
Hmph...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"There are so many kinds of shoes~~~!
Uh-huh, this is super helpful!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting.
Trying on so many things paid off, I found some great stuff♪

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!! That's wonderful!
Right, Taishin?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Taishin?
Where'd you go?
HEYYYY!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Shut up...
I came here to buy shoes too, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aah!!
Taishin, there you are!!
Hayahide, Flight, over here, over hereee!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're sizing up the merchandise quite intently.
Did you find something you resonate with, like Flight-kun?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Not really... I just figured there was nothing to lose by trying if it could reduce the strain.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? ♪
Um, would it be okay if I joined you?
I'd love to hear your thoughts too, Taishin-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While walking in front of the station, I ran into North Flight walking with the three members of BNW.
choice_data_list: So the four of you were shopping together?
Were the four of you shopping together?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...!
That's right.
We were just talking about how we'd love to go out together sometime.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Flight's explanation was super easy to follow,
I couldn't stop being amazed!!
Right, Taishin?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Well... without your help,
I might not have picked out such nice sunscreen or shoes.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Flight-kun perceives races from a multifaceted perspective.
Thanks to that, we had a very fruitful exchange of ideas.
choice_data_list: I'm sure you all would give excellent advice, too.
You all seem like you'd give spot-on advice
I'm sure you'd all have a lively discussion.
I bet a discussion with you all would really get lively

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Flight-kun perceives races from a multifaceted perspective.
Thanks to that, we had a very fruitful exchange of ideas.
choice_data_list: I'm sure you all would give excellent advice, too.
You all seem like you'd give spot-on advice
I'm sure you'd all have a lively discussion.
I bet a discussion with you all would really get lively

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Hayahide-san's formula
gave my coordination
a logical foundation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Likewise.
Intuition can be crucial in a race.
Your perspective, which resonated closely with Flight's feelings, was very helpful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both of their faces looked bright and refreshed.
Seeing how much fun they had on the flight, a smile welled up from pure joy.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: You're right! Hayahide-san's arguments have no flaws and are surprisingly persuasive!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Flight-kun's coordination as well.
It was logical yet playful, leaving me thoroughly impressed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Respecting each other, they've built a wonderful relationship.
Seeing Flight having so much fun brought a warm smile to my face.
